# Freelance Service Acceptance Criteria Builder

## Purpose
Help freelancers and clients agree what “finished” means before work starts, reducing disputes and unpaid scope expansion.

## Workflow
1. Capture the agreed objective, deliverables, formats, quantity, quality bar, and deadline.
2. Convert subjective phrases such as “modern,” “fast,” or “SEO-friendly” into observable criteria or mark them unresolved.
3. Define client inputs, dependencies, access requirements, and response deadlines.
4. Specify review rounds, feedback format, acceptance window, defect severity, and correction limits.
5. Separate included work from change requests, maintenance, hosting, licensing, and third-party fees.
6. Define handoff evidence and completion records without drafting deceptive claims or legal guarantees.
7. Flag ambiguous payment, cancellation, ownership, or dispute terms for qualified review.

## Output
Deliverable checklist, measurable acceptance tests, client dependency list, review protocol, exclusions, and sign-off template.

## Safety and limits
- Do not provide jurisdiction-specific legal advice or invent contract terms.
- Do not send agreements, invoices, or payment requests.
- Use only terms supplied or approved by the parties.
- No runtime activation or tool grants.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Scope and acceptance drafting only.
